content: Mɑnɑse
u kuɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko
Mɑnɑse u mɔwɑ wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ yiru sɑnɑm mɛ u bɑndu di Yudɑɔ. Mɑ u kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ weerɑɑkuru kɑ nɔɔbu bɑn te sɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Kɔ̃sɑ u kuɑ Yinni Gusunɔn nɔni sɔɔ. Bwese ni Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡirɑ Isirelibɑn wuswɑɑn di nin kom kɔ̃sum mɛyɑ u swĩi.

U wure u ɡunɡunu seeyɑ ni win tundo Esekiɑsi u kɔsukɑ. Mɑ u bũu wi bɑ mɔ̀ Bɑɑlin yɑ̃ku yenu kuɑ kɑ bũu wi bɑ mɔ̀ Asitɑɑten bwɑ̃ɑrokunu ni win tundo u rɑɑ kɔsukɑ. Mɑ u kperi kɑ sɔ̃ɔ kɑ surun sɑ̃ɑru wɔri.
U bũu turɑnu bɑnɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ tèn mi Yinni Gusunɔ u win yĩsiru doke sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
U mɑɑ suru kɑ sɔ̃ɔ kɑ kperin yɑ̃ku yenu kuɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee ten yɑɑri yiru ye sɔɔ.

U derɑ bɑ kɑ win bii tɔn durɔbu yɑ̃kuru kuɑ Hinɔmun wɔwɑɔ. U rɑ kɑ wɛɛ kɑ ɡuru winu sɔroru ko kpɑ u dobo dobobɑ ko. U ɡɔri sokobu yii be bɑ rɑ nùn siɑn ɡɑri sɔ̃. Mɑ u kɔ̃sɑ mɔ̀ u dɔɔ ye yɑ Yinni Gusunɔn mɔru seeyɑ.

U win bũun bwɑ̃ɑroku kuɑ u yi Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ. N deemɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u rɑɑ Dɑfidi kɑ win bii Sɑlomɔɔ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, sɑ̃ɑ yee teni kɑ Yerusɑlɛmu yeniwɑ nɑ ɡɔsɑ Isirelibɑn suunu sɔɔ yɑ n kɑ nɛn yĩsiru sɔɔwɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Nɑ ǹ mɑɑ Isirelibɑ yɑrɑmɔ sɑɑ ben tem di mɛ nɑ ben bɑɑbɑbɑ wɛ̃ bɑ̀ n ɡesi nɛn woodɑbɑ kɑ nɛn ɡere mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ ye nɑ Mɔwisi wɛ̃ u yoruɑ.
Adɑmɑ Mɑnɑse u derɑ Yudɑbɑ kɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu bɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ tondɑ, mɑ bɑ kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ n kere bwese ni Yinni Gusunɔn tii u ɡirɑ be Isirelibɑn wuswɑɑn di.
Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ Mɑnɑse kɑ win tɔmbu ɡɑri kuɑ. Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ nùn swɑɑ dɑki.
Yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Asirin sinɑ bokon tɑbu sinɑmbu ɡɔrɑ bɑ Mɑnɑse mwɑ bɑ yɔni doke, mɑ bɑ nùn bɔkuɑ kɑ sii ɡɑndun yɔni bɑ kɑ dɑ Bɑbiloniɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ u wɑ̃ɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu sɔɔ, yerɑ u tii kɑwɑ Gusunɔ win bɑɑbɑbɑn Yinnin wuswɑɑɔ. Mɑ u nùn kɑnɑ.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑ u win kɑnɑru mwɑ, u kɑ nùn wurɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ win bɑndu sɔɔ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Mɑnɑse u ɡiɑ mɑ Gusunɔwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ Yinni.

Yenibɑn biru, u ɡɑnɑ bɑnɑ Yerusɑlɛmun tɔɔwɔ Gihonin sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡiɑ wɔwɑɔ. Gɑnɑ ye, yɑ dɑwɑ sere kɔnnɔwɔ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Swɛ̃ɛ. Mɑ yɑ kɑ Yerusɑlɛmun wɔɔ berɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ Ofɛli sikerenɑ. U derɑ ɡɑnɑ ye, yɑ ɡuniɑ too. Mɑ u tɑbu sinɑmbu doke Yudɑn wuu si su ɡbɑ̃rɑnu mɔ kpuro sɔɔ.

Mɑ u tɔn tukobun bũnun bwɑ̃ɑrokunu kɑ win tiiɡuu ɡe, ni u rɑɑ doke Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ kpuro wunɑ kɑ sere bũu yɑ̃ku yee ni u bɑnɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun ɡuurɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Mɑ u nu kɑsi kuɑ wuun biruɔ.
Yerɑ u Yinni Gusunɔn yɑ̃ku yeru wesiɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ. Mɑ u siɑrɑbun yɑ̃kunu kuɑ. U Yudɑbɑ woodɑ wɛ̃ bu Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni wi turo sɑ̃.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, tɔmbɑ yɑ̃kunu mɔ̀ ɡunɡunɔ, ɑdɑmɑ Gusunɔ ben Yinniwɑ bɑ nu kuɑmmɛ.
Ye Mɑnɑse u kuɑn sukum kɑ kɑnɑ te u kuɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɑri yi win sɔmɔbu bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ, ye kpuro yɑ yoruɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑmbun fɑɑɡin tireru sɔɔ.

Win kɑnɑru kɑ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn wurɑri kɑ win torɑnu kɑ ɡunɡuu ni u kuɑ kɑ mɛm nɔɔbu sɑri te u kuɑ kɑ sere bwɑ̃ɑroku ni u sekɑ mɑ u nu ɡirɑ u sɑ̃wɑ u sere tii kɑwɑ, ye kpuron ɡɑri yi yoruɑ Hosɑin tireru sɔɔ.
Yen biruwɑ Mɑnɑse u kpunɑ u ɡu. Mɑ bɑ nùn sikuɑ win tiin dirɔ. Mɑ win bii Amɔɔ u bɑndu kɔsire kuɑ.
Amɔɔ u kuɑ sinɑ boko Yudɑɔ
Wɔ̃ɔ yɛndɑ yiruwɑ Amɔɔ u mɔ sɑnɑm mɛ u bɑndu di. Mɑ u kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ yiru bɑn te sɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Kɔ̃sɑ u kuɑ Yinni Gusunɔn nɔni sɔɔ nɡe win tundo Mɑnɑse. U bwɑ̃ɑroku ni Mɑnɑse u kuɑ kpuro yɑ̃kuru kuɑ u sɑ̃wɑ.
U ǹ tii kɑwe Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ nɡe mɛ win tundo u tii kɑwɑ. Adɑmɑ u win torɑnu sosimɔwɑ u dɔɔ.
Win sɔm kowobu bɑ nùn seesi mɑ bɑ nùn ɡo win dirɔ.
Adɑmɑ be bɑ nùn seesi bɑ ɡo mi, tɔmbɑ mɑɑ ben tii so bɑ ɡo. Mɑ bɑ win bii Yosiɑsi kɔsire kuɑ bɑndu sɔɔ.
